reviews.text: Charlie is a mutt that we got almost 2 years ago and he arrived with a relay from Calabria, initially he was problematic and it was not possible to leave him free even in the dog area because then he did not let himself be picked up, now after 1 year with the help of Daniel who has followed us for almost 1 year we can go for walks in the mountains leaving him free
Vale is very good, professional and helped us a lot with our two dogs.

My sweet Jazz and I have been doing Uppers with Valentina for a couple of months.
I'd been looking for an activity to do with him for a while, but I was having a hard time finding the right one because Jazz, a two-year-old male Pomeranian, unfortunately has a lot of issues with managing emotions and feeling confident. This, unfortunately, leads to poor concentration and anxiety.
Valentina and I are working on it, and I have to say we're seeing results! We started with a situation where he was barking constantly and unable to wait for anything. Now Jazz is able to wait without that constant, nervous, stressful barking, and I have to say he's very good at it, too! He concentrates during the training and has a lot of fun. The benefits are also visible off the field! Valentina is always ready to exchange ideas and engage in constructive discussion to help Jazz calm down. A huge thank you from me, Jazz, and his little sisters Lottie and Elodie, who finally have a playmate and no longer have to deal with the stress of their anxious little brother.
Valentina is transforming my Maltese! A great teacher 🐾❤️❤️ …

We attended a puppy class at Playdog with our Maltese puppy, but we decided to discontinue the program after the first lesson because the proposed approach wasn't compatible with our dog or the type of relationship we wanted to build with him.
During the meeting, tools such as a semi-choke collar and the use of a kennel as a training tool were suggested, along with instructions strongly oriented towards controlling the dog's behavior and contact with the owner. Some typical puppy behaviors were interpreted as signs of dominance and treated accordingly.
In our case, the puppy, very small and sensitive, showed clear signs of stress in group interactions with larger dogs. Once we returned home, we saw him looking tired and less calm than usual, and this made us realize that it wasn't the right environment for him. By delving deeper and engaging with modern ethology texts and professionals, we discovered that approaches based on hierarchical interpretations of the human-dog relationship and tools that work through physical control are now considered outdated or old-school methods, less effective in promoting mindful learning and more focused on achieving obedience through discomfort avoidance. For this reason, we chose not to continue.
For the sake of fairness, I should point out that, following our decision, the center refunded us the fee for the unused lessons.
I am writing this review for those of us who, like us, are looking for a puppy class focused on the puppy's emotional well-being and building trust: researching the training approach beforehand is essential, as the chosen method can profoundly impact the dog's relationship with its human.

I took my poodle to Playdog for hooper training and couldn't be happier! 🐾
The experience was truly fantastic: Pongo has so much fun every time, and you can see how much he looks forward to the lessons. He's learned a lot in a short time, improving his concentration, listening skills, and confidence.

The trainer is competent, patient, and very attentive to both dogs and owners, creating a calm and positive environment where learning is fun. The exercises are always stimulating and suited to the dog's abilities.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for an educational yet fun activity with their dog.

I recently had a fantastic experience at PlayDog and I can't help but share it!
I think attending this type of activity is a must for anyone who has a dog.
The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate, demonstrating excellent knowledge of training techniques.
Instructors Valentina and Daniel take the time to understand the needs of each dog and their owner, creating a welcoming and stimulating environment.

I noticed a great commitment to ensuring each dog feels comfortable and motivated during the sessions. Furthermore, the classes are structured to be fun and engaging, for both dogs and their owners.

I saw a significant improvement in my dog's behavior after just a few lessons. It's clear that the team is dedicated not only to training, but also to creating a strong bond between dog and owner. I highly recommend this center to anyone looking for a place where their four-legged friend can grow and learn in a positive and professional environment!

I've been going to PlayDog with my dog ​​for almost a year: we started with the Puppy Class and then with individual lessons. I've seen a huge positive impact on my fearful dachshund, who's become more curious, playful, and confident! Nothing but positive things to say :)

I've developed a rapport with Daniel that has allowed me to enjoy attending his center, so I thank him for understanding our needs. With Snoopy, we're adding additional skills. I'm therefore satisfied.
Thank you, Daniel

We feel it's quite unfair to leave two reviews for the same dog, especially considering that the other reviewer has never even been to the dog training facility, so we're wondering how they could have assessed us. In any case, we'll give you the same answer we gave him about your experience with Arturo.

We're sorry you haven't resolved Arturo's issues.
However, with only five lessons and without following our instructions, it was a truly daunting task.
Perhaps having changed so many trainers and not having resolved anything isn't the trainers' fault.
As we've already told you privately, we're available to evaluate together what went wrong.
We welcome constructive criticism because we care about the dogs' well-being and we like to continually improve. This requires owners to be self-critical when appropriate and to work with us to help their dogs, something that unfortunately you haven't done.

I began my journey with my dog ​​with Valentina and then continued with Simone. My dog ​​is very hyperactive (he's a Malinois cross and weighs 35 kg) and was difficult to manage at first, especially since he was my first dog on my own. With patience and perseverance, I've seen great progress in my dog, progress that has contributed to improving the quality of life for me and my dog.
We initially did obedience and agility, then obedience and playful bites, and sometimes scent tracking. The Playdog staff are always ready to suggest the best activity for you and your dog, adapting to the needs of the dog's owner and the dog itself and understanding the needs of both.
I highly recommend this experience to anyone with a dog of any size. My relationship with my dog ​​has become special and beautiful.

I met PlayDog about two years ago, when my little Elly came into my life. Thanks to their support and the activities they organize, I've been able to raise my dog ​​and build a wonderful relationship with her.

I've attended both their puppy classes and weekend activities and have always found great attention to each dog's needs, combined with a truly rare passion. The activities are carefully structured and prove extremely helpful in creating a strong, healthy bond between owner and dog.

Thanks to their advice and teachings (which I still ask for, even though Elly is now grown!), I've always received countless compliments from those who meet her. I should point out that she's a Jack Russell, but she's so good she almost seems "out of the ordinary" compared to other dogs of her breed! 🐶✨

We worked with Daniel, who was always very clear in his explanations and directions, which made everything easier and more effective. Thanks to his support, the program not only helped our dachshund overcome her insecurities but also strengthened our relationship.

We are truly satisfied and will definitely continue! A team of competent and passionate professionals, highly recommended! 🐶👏

Playdog is a truly serious organization. They listen to your needs and help you. I arrived with my dog ​​Mia, and every time she came into the dog area, I couldn't get her to come out. I worked with Daniel on how to get Mia to recognize my role as "pack leader." The first thing we did was switch from a comb to a collar to a martingale. As soon as he suggested it, my reaction was, "No, you're killing me!" I trusted him, bought it, and came back for the next lesson, thanking him because it changed my life! Mia is more confident, less afraid of surrounding noises, she releases her tension on me, and combined with the work we're doing, she's returning to the dog area when called. I've seen big changes after 7 lessons. Daniel gives me a lot of advice. If he sees Mia getting tired during the lesson, he knows how to handle it. He uses a nice, gentle and gentle method with both the dog and the owner. He explains things based on scientific principles. And I, who am super protective of my dog, am very happy with him. I highly recommend Playdog for their professionalism, humanity, preparation and respect for the dog.
